channel.title: Alabama Political Reporter - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Alabama Political Reporter (alreporter.com)

item.title: ADOW highlights recent $11M grant to Broad Metro
item.description: Federal funding was awarded to two innovative Hoover projects that aim to eliminate environmental hazards and drive economic growth in coal-impacted communities.

item.title: Alabama State receives Carnegie community engagement classification
item.description: The prestigious honor placed ASU among only 277 institutions nationwide recognized for exceptional commitment to service and social impact.

item.title: Gov. Ivey announces special guests for her final State of the State address
item.description: Gov. Kay Ivey announced the Alabama heroes and talented students who will be recognized during her final State of the State address Tuesday.

item.title: NFIB commends Gov. Ivey ahead of final State of the State address
item.description: NFIB thanked Gov. Kay Ivey for successful efforts to lower costs and reduce taxes, creating a better climate for Alabama's small business owners.

item.title: ALGOP chairman: Republicans are ready for a productive 2026 Legislative Session
item.description: Wahl said lawmakers have laid important groundwork, pre-filing several pieces of legislation ahead of the 2026 session.

item.title: Alabama bill would let retired teachers drive school buses
item.description: House Bill 138, filed by state Rep. Kenneth Paschal, would allow public school teachers and state employees to drive buses without losing their retirement.

item.title: Stand Up Mobile celebrates five years of voting advocacy
item.description: Attendees reflected on voting rights history and ballot access challenges during the celebration, featuring a keynote from civil rights activist Maya Wiley.

item.title: Opinion | Protest is moral, change requires strategy
item.description: The machinery of authority depends on routine obedience. History shows that when citizens withdraw it—patiently, lawfully and together—even the most entrenched systems bend.

item.title: Alabama Arise discusses 2026 legislative priorities before session begins
item.description: Alabama Arise outlines 2026 priorities on hunger, education, justice and workers' rights, while urging early advocacy in a fast paced session.

item.title: Report: No Alabama county saw more than 3 votes cast by noncitizens
item.description: Three in four Alabama counties were found to have no record of noncitizen voting activity.
